relationships.subject: Anterior medial thalamic nucleus
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that the AM, a major nucleus from anterior thalamic nuclei, projected directly to ipsilateral ACC and showed a dense labeling.

relationships.subject: Mediodorsal thalamic nucleus lateral part
relationships.evidence_quote: The mediodorsal nuclei displayed strong labeling of DsRed+ neurons, especially in the MDl.

relationships.subject: Mediodorsal thalamic nucleus lateral part
relationships.evidence_quote: the MD neurons directly excite parvalbumin-positive interneurons in the dorsal ACC to mediate feed-forward inhibition of layer III of the ACC

key_findings: Rabies tracing with VISoR imaging shows ACC receives monosynaptic input from anterior, ventral, medial, lateral, midline and intralaminar thalamic nuclei, strongest from AM, MDl, VM, VAL, CL
Thalamic inputs to ACC are predominantly ipsilateral
